purpose: Task-to-file routing map for AI agents. Use before broad repository search.

domains.title: Gateway runtime and agent invocation
use_when: agent discovery or invoke behavior changes
agent credentials or credential status changes
provider service runtime routing changes
runtime API contract or error code changes
notes: Runtime behavior changes require docs and tests in the same change.
Do not infer SDK behavior from old quote-first flows; current flow is discovery/search plus invoke plus receipt.

domains.title: Dedicated public developer docs
use_when: the task mentions http://localhost:3100
the task mentions docs.synapse-network.ai or docs-staging.synapse-network.ai
SDK docs page copy or examples need to change
API reference UI, OpenAPI generation, or endpoint docs change
docs navigation, llms.txt, sitemap, robots, or public documentation status labels change
notes: Public docs must match current SDK README and gateway endpoints.
OpenAPI JSON is generated from docs-front endpoint source until Gateway schema generation becomes canonical.
Do not use stale gateway domain examples.

domains.title: User-front docs links
use_when: the task mentions main-site Docs navigation
the task mentions removal of /docs legacy redirects
NEXT_PUBLIC_DOCS_BASE_URL changes
product UI links need to open the dedicated docs origin
notes: Main-site /docs/* is not a supported entrypoint; product links must open the environment-specific docs domain directly.
Browser code must use static NEXT_PUBLIC_DOCS_BASE_URL access so Next can inline public env values.

domains.title: User-facing product frontend
use_when: marketplace, console, landing, or visible product page changes
responsive UI or copy quality changes
frontend user journey changes
notes: Frontend work should preserve product-facing polish and avoid leaking internal debug copy.

domains.title: SDK contract alignment in product docs
use_when: SDK README and gateway docs disagree
public preview, staging, or prod SDK examples change
Python or TypeScript SDK method names are documented in product docs
notes: This domain crosses repositories. Check the SDK repo before changing public SDK examples here.

domains.title: Finance-sensitive backend
use_when: balance, deposit, withdrawal, refund, settlement, ledger, reconciliation, or audit changes
money movement or idempotency behavior changes
notes: Never use floats for money.
Do not auto-run destructive database or contract operations.

domains.title: Admin finance control plane
use_when: gateway-admin finance review changes
admin-front withdrawal, refund, or reconciliation UI changes
operator approval or audit trail changes
notes: Admin finance changes usually require evidence docs and careful operator workflow review.

domains.title: Local and staging E2E regression evidence
use_when: the task mentions regression testing, full-chain E2E, or staging dogfood
the task asks what to run before release approval
the task needs SQL evidence for provider registration, deposit, invoke, withdrawal, notifications, analytics, or contract state
notes: API and UI E2E are incomplete for money paths until read-only SQL evidence proves Postgres state.
Staging SQL validation must use approved read-only access and must not repair data during regression.

domains.title: Contracts and deployment evidence
use_when: Solidity, Hardhat, contract deployment, staging contract evidence, or chain configuration changes
notes: Contract deployments are irreversible enough to require explicit operator intent before execution.

domains.title: Documentation governance
use_when: README metadata, retired paths, canonical docs, llms.txt, AGENTS, or docs checks change
notes: Every docs README entrypoint needs the required metadata block.
Do not reintroduce retired paths.

domains.title: CI and quality gates
use_when: package scripts, CI wrappers, validation commands, or PR gate behavior changes
quality-budget, file-size, function-length, complexity, or PR-template rules change
notes: Use docs/reference/Engineering_Quality_Guardrails.md as the quality-budget source of truth.
Keep local scripts and GitHub Actions entrypoints aligned.

PR CI is dynamically scoped; workflow and ordinary CI-tool changes should run CI meta checks without forcing full CI unless they touch root dependencies, deploy scripts, security, finance, or unknown paths.

domains.title: Weekly cleanup, code review, and repository hygiene
use_when: the task mentions weekly cleanup, garbage cleanup, stale evidence, stale PRs, or repository hygiene
the task changes recurring cleanup/review automation
the task asks what should run in the Sunday hygiene harness
notes: Weekly hygiene is Report + Issue by default and must not auto-delete tracked files or mutate staging/prod data.
New recurring cleanup tasks need a command, an evidence checker, and a runbook.

domains.title: Codex token optimization and memory hygiene
use_when: Codex memory settings or high-frequency usage policy changes
the task asks how to reduce token usage without reducing capability
AGENTS, llms.txt, task maps, handoff summaries, or context-routing guidance changes
notes: Keep bridge files short; route to reference docs instead of copying long guidance into startup context.
Memory guidance must not encourage storing secrets, customer data, or temporary branch-specific findings.
